text:
Digital matte painting, wide 16:9 landscape composition, cinematic sci-fi desert at dusk. Foreground: rippled golden sand dunes sweeping from bottom edge toward the center, with fine wind-blown sand streaks drifting left. On the left-foreground dune ridge stand two figures facing right toward the city: a fluffy tan-and-cream alpaca on the far left, and beside it a lone human in a long flowing crimson-maroon cloak with hood down, back partly turned, seen from behind. Upper left: a large pale crescent moon, slightly glowing, with faint stars scattered across a deep indigo-to-navy sky. Horizon glows warm orange and peach fading into dusky violet at the edges.

Center-right: a futuristic city skyline with glowing teal and cyan accents. The tallest central tower is a slender glass spire crowned by a luminous cyan halo ring. Two flanking towers: a slim blade-like tower on the left with a vertical neon sign reading "OASIS" in cyan letters, and a sharp violet-lit tower on the right with magenta-purple neon edges. Low tiered saucer-like plazas with teal lighting sit at the base. Cyan laser beams rise diagonally from the city into the sky. Small illuminated buildings dot the skyline.

Right foreground: a tall saguaro cactus outlined in glowing magenta-pink neon, with a smaller cactus behind it. Beside it a turquoise reflective oasis pool. A curving elevated monorail track with warm amber-gold light winds from the right middle toward the lower right, carrying a sleek silver train.

Style: photorealistic synthwave concept art, soft volumetric haze, rich contrast between warm sand tones and cool cyan-violet neon, cinematic depth of field, high detail.
